available_actions.name: action_attack
available_actions.description: The agent attacks a designated NPC in the current area; deals single-round damage based on agent's attack power. If NPC is in 'defend' state, damage is reduced to 25%.

available_actions.name: action_buy
available_actions.description: Buy a specified amount of an object from a merchant NPC using coins.

available_actions.name: action_craft
available_actions.description: The agent crafts a specified amount of an object if all necessary ingredients and dependencies are met.

available_actions.name: action_defend
available_actions.description: The agent takes a defensive stance. If attacked by an NPC while defending, damage received is reduced to 10%. Defending also partially recovers stamina.

available_actions.name: action_disassemble
available_actions.description: Break down a craftable object (in hand or on the ground; not while equipped) into some of its original ingredients.

available_actions.name: action_discard
available_actions.description: The agent discards a specified amount of an object from a designated container or inventory.

available_actions.name: action_drop
available_actions.description: The agent drops an object from hand to the current area.

available_actions.name: action_eat
available_actions.description: Consume a food item to restore HP.

available_actions.name: action_enter
available_actions.description: The agent enters a designated neighboring area; if the path is locked, a key is required to unlock it. Cannot leave during active combat.

available_actions.name: action_equip
available_actions.description: The agent equips an object from hand, either as armor or as the inventory container.

available_actions.name: action_inspect
available_actions.description: The agent inspects an object to obtain its text content, or inspects inventory to see its contents.

available_actions.name: action_lockpick
available_actions.description: Attempt to silently unlock a neighboring locked path without a key.

available_actions.name: action_pick_up
available_actions.description: The agent picks up an object from the current area.

available_actions.name: action_pickpocket
available_actions.description: Attempt to stealthily steal from an NPC in the current area.

available_actions.name: action_sell
available_actions.description: Sell a specified amount of an object to a merchant NPC. Payout is 0.5 times the real value of the objects.

available_actions.name: action_store
available_actions.description: The agent stores a specified amount of an object into a designated container or inventory.

available_actions.name: action_take_out
available_actions.description: The agent takes out an object from a designated container or inventory into hand.

available_actions.name: action_talk_to
available_actions.description: The agent talks to a designated NPC in the current area to receive dialogue.

available_actions.name: action_throw
available_actions.description: Hurl an object in hand at an NPC in the same area, dealing instant damage without immediate counterattack.

available_actions.name: action_unequip
available_actions.description: The agent unequips an equipped object back into hand.

available_actions.name: action_wait
available_actions.description: The agent waits for a while without taking any action. During combat, waiting fully recovers stamina.

available_actions.name: action_write
available_actions.description: The agent writes text on a writable object, if holding writing tools.
